attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012168723 (CC0): the banded dark brick school fronts with red courses, segment-headed ground-floor windows, round-arched first-floor windows with patterned tympana, the console frieze and white cornice, and the pointed pavilion topgevels with oculi, copings, pinnacles and finials, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0).
